question:
Two men stand on opposite sides of a temple 30 m high. Distance between them is $40/\sqrt3$ m and distance from A to temple is $30/\sqrt3$ m.

(i) Express $\alpha$ in terms of $\sin^{-1}$.

(ii) Express $\alpha$ in terms of $\cos^{-1}$.

(iii) Express $\beta$ in terms of $\tan^{-1}$.

OR find domain and range of $\cos^{-1}x$.
explanation:
(i) $\sin\alpha=\frac{30}{20\sqrt3}=\frac{\sqrt3}{2}$ so $\alpha=\sin^{-1}(\sqrt3/2)$.

(ii) $\cos\alpha=\frac{1}{2}$ so $\alpha=\cos^{-1}(1/2)$.

(iii) $\tan\beta=3\sqrt3$ so $\beta=\tan^{-1}(3\sqrt3)$.

OR domain of $\cos^{-1}x=[-1,1]$ and range $[0,\pi]$.
